 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *Think carefully of the consequences. *

• *Example: Parking illegally in front of the police station is **looking for trouble.***

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Mother said to Kavya, "Switch off the light before you go to sleep."

options.text: Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before she goes to sleep.
Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before she went to sleep.
Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before you go to sleep.
Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before she is going to sleep.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before she went to sleep'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech.** As per the given question we have to change it into **Indirect Speech. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows: ​
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an Imperative Sentence. 
 
• Transformation of Imperative Sentence. 
 
• 'Orders', 'Command', 'Request', 'Advice' are given in these kinds of sentences. 
 
• Reporting Verb is changed into 'ordered, advised, requested, commanded, beg, forbade, suggested, proposed, assured, asked, reminded, warned, agreed, refused, promised', etc. 
 
• Inverted Commas will be removed. And conjunction 'to/not to' will be used. 
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *He said, "Mohan, please bring me my towel." (Direct Speech)*
 
• *He requested Mohan to bring him his towel. (Indirect Speech)*
 
 
 
• **'Said to'** will be changed into **'told'** because **the reporting verb** has 'object'. 
 
• **Comma and inverted commas** will be removed. 
 
• **'To'** conjunction will be added.
 
• **'Go'** will be changed into** 'went'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2. ****
 ​

Thus the correct sentence is:__** *"Mother told Kavya to switch off the light before she went to sleep."*

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. People in a small Chinese town were shocked to see a wild elephant wandering in their town.

B. The elephant eventually left the town.

C. Authorities followed the large mammal’s every movement.

D. But the locals will probably never forget this special visit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'ACBD'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of **Sentence Jumble. **
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually **an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.** 
 
• **Part A** will be the first sentence because **it starts with an incident.** *'People were shocked to see a wild elephant...'* it is the starting of an incident. 
 
• **Part C **will be the next sentence because we know that **a wild elephant entered the town.** **Part A** tells about that. 
 
• Therefore, it would be followed by authorities. Therefore,** Part C** will be the next sentence. 
 
• **Part B **will be the next sentence because the elephant **itself left the town. **
 
• Lastly, **Part D** will be used. 

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *People in a small Chinese town were shocked to see a wild elephant wandering in their town. Authorities followed the large mammal’s every movement. The elephant eventually left the town. But the locals will probably never forget this special visit.*

**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. When he returned, there was more than just his dog waiting for him.

B. A koala had joined the dog in the car’s more comfortable climate.

C. A winemaker in South Australia left his air-conditioned car open to help keep his dog cool in the heat.

D. Although the human struggled a while to make the koala leave, it did leave his car eventually.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CABD'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• **Part C** will be the first sentence because it starts with an incident.* 'A winemaker in South Australia left his air-conditioned car open...' *is the starting of an incident. 
 
• **Part C **ends with the winemakers' left air-conditioner open to help keep his dog cool in the heat. 
 
• After the winemakers' return, he saw many dogs. Therefore, the next sentence is** Part A. **Because** Part C and Part A** are connected. 
 
• **Part B** will be the next sentence because **'dog's'** were joined by **'koala'. **
 
• Lastly, **Part D** will be used. 

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *A winemaker in South Australia left his air-conditioned car open to help keep his dog cool in the heat. When he returned, there was more than just his dog waiting for him. A koala had joined the dog in the car’s more comfortable climate. Although the human struggled a while to make the koala leave, it did leave his car eventually.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

He spent a lot of money on movies.

options.text: A lot of money had been spent by him on movies.
A lot of money is spent by him on movies.
A lot of money was spent by him on movies.
A lot of money was being spent by him on movies.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'A lot of money was spent by him on movies.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is in **Active Voice.** As per the given question we have to change it into **Passive Voice. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows: 
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is **'He'. **
 
• **The object** of the given sentence is **'A lot of money'. **
 
• **The subject** will be put in place of **the object** and **the object **will be put in place of **the subject. **
 
• **'Spent'** will be changed into** 'was spent' **because we know that** V₂ **is changed into** 'was+V₃.'**
 
• **'He'** will be changed into **'him'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3. **

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *A lot of money was spent by him on movies. *
